mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_stocktaking_detail WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_del = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT s.id AS id, s.spu_id AS spuId, s.code AS skuCode, COALESCE(s.spec, s.title, '') AS skuName, p.sub_title AS spuCode, p.title AS spuName, c.name AS categoryName, p.category_id1 AS categoryId, COALESCE(p.weight_unit, '件') AS unit, COALESCE(s.real_price, s.price, 0.00) AS inPrice, COALESCE(s.price, 0.00) AS price, COALESCE(inv.book_count, 0) AS bookCount FROM wms_item_sku s INNER JOIN wms_item_spu p ON s.spu_id = p.id AND p.is_del = 1 LEFT JOIN wms_item_category c ON c.id = p.category_id1 AND c.is_del = 1
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(total_count) AS book_count FROM wms_inventory WHERE is_del = 1 AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} GROUP BY sku_id ) inv ON inv.sku_id = s.id
s.is_del = 1
AND s.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuCode}, '%')
AND (s.spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuName}, '%') OR s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuName}, '%'))
AND p.sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{spuCode}, '%')
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{spuName}, '%')
AND (p.category_id1 = #{categoryId} OR p.category_id2 = #{categoryId} OR p.category_id3 = #{categoryId})
ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT s.id AS id, s.spu_id AS spuId, s.code AS skuCode, COALESCE(s.spec, s.title, '') AS skuName, p.sub_title AS spuCode, p.title AS spuName, c.name AS categoryName, p.category_id1 AS categoryId, COALESCE(p.weight_unit, '件') AS unit, COALESCE(s.real_price, s.price, 0.00) AS inPrice, COALESCE(s.price, 0.00) AS price, inv.book_count AS bookCount FROM ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(total_count) AS book_count FROM wms_inventory WHERE is_del = 1 AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} GROUP BY sku_id ) inv INNER JOIN wms_item_sku s ON s.id = inv.sku_id AND s.is_del = 1 INNER JOIN wms_item_spu p ON s.spu_id = p.id AND p.is_del = 1 LEFT JOIN wms_item_category c ON c.id = p.category_id1 AND c.is_del = 1 ORDER BY s.id ASC
